mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 35 degrees that feels like 25 under a waning gibbous moon. The overnight low will drop down to 31 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, candidate information packets are now available for the 2027 Spring Election, which will feature open seats in all four City of Verona Aldermanic Districts. Candidates must file required paperwork in person with the City Clerk by January 5th, 2027.

Looking ahead to local events, tomorrow brings live music to Bailey's Run Vineyard and a 50-year craft brewing celebration to Wisconsin Brewing Company. On Saturday, November 28th, you can check out The Crafty Fair at ART House 360 or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.

In the weekly police recap, on Sunday, November 8th, officers responded to a single-vehicle crash on South Main Street where a car struck a curb, tree, and light pole before catching fire; the driver was arrested for O W I.
Culver's of Verona is closed for the night. They will reopen tomorrow at 10 AM, serving up Snickers Swirl as the flavor of the day.
